author: Gretchen Bolander
title: CJPD seeks animal lover for part-time animal control role - NewsBreak
text:
By Gretchen Bolander No media credit provided. ,
6 hours ago
CARL JUNCTION, Mo. — Carl Junction police are looking for someone to focus on helping Fido and Fluffy when they go missing.
CJPD is looking for someone to take over as a part-time animal control and code enforcement officer. Officers say they deal with a good number of pets gone missing, leading to a search for owners and that’s just the beginning of the job.
“And then in conjunction with the code enforcement, uh, he goes out and looks for nuisance violation. Whether it’s junk autos, overgrown yards, trash brush, whatever it is. That’s kind of a proactive job for him to do,” said CJPD Chief Mark McCall.
Applicants only need a high school diploma or GED to apply—training will be provided. The job will become a full-time position down the road.
